$sources: CFE Manual de Diseño de Obras Civiles, Diseño por Viento (2008): Sec 4.2.3 (Frz by terrain category, Tabla 4.2.3), Sec 4.2.5 (qz = 0.0048 G VD²), Sec 4.3 (static pressures, Cp of the walls)
source: CFE Viento 2008 (the power law of the program: Kz = Frz² = c² (z/10)^(2α) with Frz = c below 10 m; the town's G in its pressure factor; the cladding, internal pressure and roof coefficients the parent's ASCE 7-22 / BNBC values until checked)

cat1.description: Categoría 1: open flat terrain, water surfaces, practically without obstructions

cat2.description: Categoría 2: flat or undulating terrain with few obstructions (farmland, scattered isolated buildings)

cat3.description: Categoría 3: terrain covered by many close obstructions (suburbs, light industry, forests)

cat4.description: Categoría 4: terrain with many large, tall, close obstructions (city centres)

sources.exposures: CFE Viento 2008 Tabla 4.2.3: Frz = c (z/10)^α for 10 m < z < δ, c below 10 m; (α, c) = (0.099, 1.137), (0.128, 1.000), (0.156, 0.881), (0.170, 0.815) for categories 1-4, written as Kz = Frz² = c² (max(z, 10)/10)^(2α) (the program's α = 1/α of CFE); the gradient height δ (245-455 m) is not applied
sources.topographic: FT = 1.0 (flat terrain); the CFE topography factor is not covered (topography: none)
sources.gust: CFE Viento 2008 Sec 4.3: static pressures pz = Cp qz of rigid structures (Tipo 1) with VD a 3-second gust: no gust factor (1.0); flexible structures (dynamic factor) are not covered
sources.cpWindward: CFE Viento 2008 Tabla 4.3.1: windward wall Cp = 0.8 (the parent's value, the same)
sources.cpLeeward: CFE Viento 2008 Tabla 4.3.2: leeward wall Cp by d/b (the parent's values, the same form: to be checked)
